label: TP
reason: User input from the Referer header flows directly to response.getWriter().format(). Although the code attempts to replace the last character with 'Z', this does not sanitize HTML entities (preventing XSS) nor does it block format string specifiers (like %n) located earlier in the string. The vulnerability remains exploitable.

evidence.note: Input source: request.getHeaders("Referer") retrieves user-controlled data.
URL decoding performed but no HTML encoding or XSS sanitization applied.
Attempted mitigation replaces only the last character with 'Z', leaving the rest of the tainted string exposed.
Sink: response.getWriter().format() writes tainted variable 'bar' to response, enabling XSS and Format String attacks.
